description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android app that manages immersive mode. It extends a custom base activity, initializes logging, and manages a fragment for immersive mode functionality.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main launcher activity for the Android app that initializes logging and manages the immersive mode fragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, inflates the layout, and adds the ImmersiveModeFragment if not already present.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment for on-screen logging.
